title: Core: hit-test point in shape path
description: Implement point-in-shape hit testing in packages/core/src/engine/hittest.ts. Function: hitTestPoint(obj: DisplayObject, x: number, y: number): boolean. For ShapeDisplayObject: use ray-casting algorithm against shape paths. For SymbolInstance: use bounding box (x/y/width/height with rotation). For TextDisplayObject: bounding box. For GroupObject: recursively test children. Export from engine/index.ts. Add unit tests with simple shapes.
